The kings are coming for the crown. 👑 Night of Kings hits Azúcar with special guest Slayonce — the dancing king of Tri-Cities himself — bringing a showstopping performance (and tons of ass) straight to Cherry Pop's stage. This is an ALL KING drag show, and Pasco has never seen the lineup quite like this. Leather, grit, and grind take over the room the second the lights drop. Mark it, tell your people, clear your Sunday — this is the one you don't want to hear about after the fact. 🔥🖤

📅 Sunday, September 13 | Doors 7PM / Show 8PM
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
💵 $5
🔞 21+

Leather. Grit. Grind. That's the air in Azúcar the second Night of Kings takes over. 🖤 Feel the bass low in your chest, the room dim except for the stage lights catching every sharp angle, every hard stare. Slayonce — Tri-Cities' dancing king — moves like the floor owes him something, and by the time he's done you're not sitting, you're on your feet. Cherry Pop keeps the energy razor sharp all night, host with the most turning up the heat between every number. This isn't soft, this isn't quiet — this is a Sunday that hits like a Sunday. Come feel it. 🔥

Bring the leather jacket, the eyeliner, the confidence you've been saving — Night of Kings is for everybody who's ever wanted to see kings run the whole show. 👑✨ No dress code except showing up ready to scream for talent. Special guest Slayonce, the dancing king of Tri-Cities, leads a lineup that's all king, all night, hosted by Cherry Pop. This is your Latinx family's living room turned stage — come as you are, sit where you land, leave with your voice half gone from cheering. Azúcar's door is open, the floor is warm, and there's a seat with your name on it. 🖤
